narrative_prose: The dense warmth of the hearth presses outward against the chilling draft of the valley floor, the copper kettles glowing a deep umber in the low light. Plumes of spiced steam catch the erratic flickers of the ferrofluid manifold's ambient glow. It is a tight, secure sanctuary of boiling stock and scrubbed metal, anchoring the chaotic sprawl of the settlement. The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea threatens to destabilize the thirty-gallon steam-jacketed kettle, so Ryn adjusts the valves to ensure thermodynamic equilibrium. If the thermal buffer fails, the week's myco-protein harvest is lost to carbonization. With the galley finally quiet, Ryn wipes her brow and firmly presses the baton into Silas's awaiting hand.
